app.name: AegisVault
app.footer: Your vault, encrypted on your device.

landing.heroLead: Generate, evaluate, store and share credentials with client-side encryption. Designed for individuals, families and teams that need to keep secrets in their own hands.
landing.featureTitle: Three promises we make in writing

featureItems.csrfTitle: Encrypted before it leaves your device
featureItems.csrfBody: Vault contents never leave your browser in plaintext. The server stores only ciphertext, digest and metadata.
featureItems.otpBody: Share secrets through self-destructing links that can be revoked and expire. The decryption key never crosses the server.
featureItems.selfBody: Deploy on a Linux host with Docker Compose. Your data stays on your infrastructure.

generator.title: Password generator
generator.lead: Generate strong passwords locally with cryptographically secure randomness. Nothing is sent to a server.
generator.requireEach: Require at least one of each class
generator.copyFailed: Copy failed - select the text manually
generator.notice: Your clipboard is controlled by your operating system and browser. Clear sensitive values after use.
generator.entropyBits: {count, plural, one {# bit} other {# bits}} of entropy

strength.title: Strength tester
strength.lead: Evaluation runs entirely in your browser - the password never leaves your device.
strength.improvementFooter: Consider length, character variety, and avoiding predictable patterns.

share.createLead: Encrypt a secret in your browser and obtain a one-time link. The decryption key never reaches our servers.
share.resultLead: Share this link with the recipient. Once they open it, the secret will be revealed exactly once.
share.revealLead: This link gives access to a secret exactly one time. Confirming will permanently invalidate the link.
share.revealNotice: After confirmation, the link becomes permanently unavailable.
share.expired: This link is no longer available.
share.consumed: This link has already been used.
share.revoked: This link was revoked by its creator.
share.selectWarning: Clipboard API is not available. Please select the text manually and copy it.

auth.signupLead: Your password is hashed on the server; your vault unlocking secret never leaves your device.
auth.loginLead: Use your email and password. Multi-factor authentication will be required if enabled.
auth.recoveryLead: Use a recovery code you saved when creating your account.
auth.verifyLead: We have sent a confirmation code to your inbox.
auth.mfaLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or your recovery code.
auth.consentTerms: I accept the terms of service.
auth.weakPasswordBody: Use a long, easy-to-remember phrase instead of a short complex one. Passwords you can paste and that support unicode are accepted.
auth.verifyHelp: Enter the 6-digit code generated by the previous step.
auth.verifyMismatch: Code does not match. Check the digits.
auth.verifyExpired: Code expired. Restart the flow to receive a new one.
auth.verifyDevNotice: In this client-side demo, the verification code is shown on screen instead of being sent by email.
auth.verifyExpiresIn: {count, plural, one {Expires in # minute.} other {Expires in # minutes.}}
auth.mfaSetupLead: Scan the code in any TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) or paste the secret manually.
auth.mfaSetupStep1: Step 1: add AegisVault to your authenticator app.
auth.mfaSetupStep2: Step 2: enter the 6-digit code that your app shows for {issuer}.
auth.mfaMismatch: Code did not match. Try again with the current code from your authenticator.
auth.unlockLead: Enter your email and master passphrase to derive keys locally. Nothing leaves the device.
auth.unlockInvalid: Email or passphrase do not match.
auth.unlockFirst: You must complete signup before this step.
auth.unlockIdleLead: For your safety, the vault locked itself when no activity was detected. Re-enter your passphrase to continue.
